name: POST /api/dialer/campaigns/:campaign_id/resume - Resume a paused campaign
description: Moves a paused campaign back to running. (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC1). Lifecycle: draft -start-> running <-pause/resume-> paused; draft|running|paused -cancel-> cancelled (terminal). Repeating the action that produced the current status is a no-op. The agent is re-checked, so a campaign cannot resume onto an agent that was since unpublished or kill-switched. Every status change emits voice.campaign.progressed.v1 {campaign_id, agent_id, status, trigger, total, by_status} (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC2 — campaign progress is emitted as voice.campaign.progressed.v1); contact uploads emit it at most once per DIALER_PROGRESS_THROTTLE_MS (default 5 s) per campaign.

testCases.name: Refuse to resume a campaign that was never paused

errorCases.message: cannot resume a campaign that is <status>
errorCases.when: the campaign is draft, cancelled or completed

errorCases.message: the agent is inbound-only and cannot place outbound calls | the agent has no published version | the agent's kill switch is engaged
errorCases.when: the campaign's agent cannot place calls
